content.user_title: Parse Hybrid Video Content with MaxHub
content.value_statement: Teams need a consistent way to parse public video links across supported platforms. This skill guides MaxHub HybridParser calls with clear limits and API key handling.
actual_capabilities: Documents authentication with MAXHUB_API_KEY and MAXHUB_BASE_URL.
Identifies the hybrid video data endpoint and its required url parameter.
Provides safe GET request examples for public video link parsing.
Explains paging, batch size, chain depth, and cost control limits.
Guides parameter checks before making a MaxHub API request.
limitations: Requires a valid MaxHub API key before use.
Only one hybrid video data endpoint is confirmed in the catalog.
Does not provide confirmed POST endpoints for this skill.
Does not bypass platform controls or collect private data.

use_cases.title: Parse a Public Video Link
use_cases.description: Submit a supported public video URL and receive guidance for requesting its structured MaxHub data.

use_cases.title: Plan Controlled API Usage
use_cases.description: Estimate call counts, paging limits, and cost warnings before running repeated MaxHub requests.

use_cases.title: Validate Integration Parameters
use_cases.description: Check the required URL parameter, API key header, and base URL before building a client workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Parse One Link
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one public URL.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the MaxHub hybrid parser for this public video URL: [paste URL]. Show the required parameter and expected result summary.

prompt_templates.title: Check Request Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my MaxHub hybrid request plan for [paste URL]. Confirm the endpoint, required header, base URL, and missing inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Small Batch
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare several public links with cost control.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a safe MaxHub parsing plan for these public video URLs: [list URLs]. Include call count, limits, and confirmation points.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Integration Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a MaxHub HybridParser workflow for our content review process. Include parameter validation, rate limits, error handling, and privacy boundaries.

output_examples.input: Parse this public video URL with MaxHub HybridParser.
output_examples.output: The response should summarize the requested video data, note any missing fields, and identify the source URL used for parsing.

output_examples.input: Plan parsing for eight public video links.
output_examples.output: The plan should list eight expected calls, confirm the batch is within limits, and request approval before execution.

output_examples.input: Check whether my hybrid parser setup is ready.
output_examples.output: The review should confirm the API key header, trusted base URL, required url parameter, and documented GET endpoint.

best_practices: Use a trusted MAXHUB_BASE_URL before sending an API key.
Confirm call count and cost before batch parsing.
Parse only public URLs that you are allowed to process.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into prompts or shared documents.
Do not use the skill to collect private or sensitive personal data.
Do not run large batches without checking rate limits and cost.

faq.question: What does this skill parse?
faq.answer: It documents use of the MaxHub HybridParser video data endpoint for supported public video URLs.

faq.question: Does it need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill expects MAXHUB_API_KEY to be available as an environment variable.

faq.question: Can it call any confirmed POST endpoint?
faq.answer: No. The current catalog confirms only a GET endpoint for hybrid video data.

faq.question: Does it store credentials?
faq.answer: No evidence of credential storage appears in the reviewed files.

faq.question: Can it process private content?
faq.answer: No. The documentation limits use to public data and says not to collect sensitive personal data.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
